Czech Extraliga (ELH) S3 bucket listing

Source: R/elh.R
elh_list_objects.Rd

One page (up to 1,000 keys) of the hokej.cz S3 bucket listing (ListObjects V1); match keys carry the hokej.cz game id. The bucket is NOT Extraliga-only, and the listing has no league field: see elh_game_ids(). Keys of a few hundred bytes are files written ahead of a game.

Usage

elh_list_objects(
  prefix = NULL,
  delimiter = NULL,
  marker = NULL,
  max_keys = NULL,
  list_type = NULL,
  continuation_token = NULL,
  start_after = NULL,
  return_parsed = TRUE
)

Arguments

prefix

Key prefix, e.g. match/2026/full/ or visualization/shots/.

delimiter

/ groups keys below the next slash into CommonPrefixes (folder view).

marker

ListObjects V1 paging: the last Key of the previous page; repeat until IsTruncated is false (V1 sends NextMarker only with a delimiter).

max_keys

Page size, at most 1000 (the default).

list_type

2 switches to ListObjectsV2 (KeyCount, NextContinuationToken); omitted = V1 as documented here.

continuation_token

V2 only (list_type = 2): NextContinuationToken of the previous page.

start_after

V2 only (list_type = 2): list keys after this key.

return_parsed

Parse the page into a tibble (default TRUE). Pass FALSE for the raw ListObjects XML page as text.

Value

A tibble (return_parsed = TRUE; hokejcz_game_id is NA for any key that is not match/{season}/full/{id}.json), else the raw XML text:

col_nametypedescription
hokejcz_game_idintegerhokej.cz game id (the S3 file name; shots match.id, scoreboard hokejcz_id). integer.
keycharacterS3 object key, e.g. match/2026/full/2928255.json.
last_modifiedcharacterLast write of the object, ISO-8601 UTC.
sizeintegerObject size in bytes (a few hundred bytes = a file written ahead of the game).

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: HTTP 404. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: a body that is not a ListBucketResult, a truncated page without a key to page on, an empty 200, or any other non-2xx. fastRhockey_bad_request: HTTP 400/422.

See also

Other ELH Functions: elh_events(), elh_game_ids(), elh_pbp(), elh_pbp_goals(), elh_pbp_latest(), elh_pbp_mobile(), elh_scoreboard(), elh_shots()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(elh_list_objects(prefix = "match/2026/full/", max_keys = "3"))
#> ── ELH List Objects Information from hokej.cz ──────── fastRhockey 1.0.0.9000 ──
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-10-18 12:02:28 UTC
#> # A tibble: 3 × 4
#>   hokejcz_game_id key                          last_modified             size
#>             <int> <chr>                        <chr>                    <int>
#> 1         2928255 match/2026/full/2928255.json 2026-09-16T18:57:27.000Z 76217
#> 2         2928256 match/2026/full/2928256.json 2026-09-16T18:24:43.000Z 98469
#> 3         2928257 match/2026/full/2928257.json 2026-09-16T20:46:31.000Z 81005
# }
